paragraphs: (Avital, David’s wife, [II Samuel 3:4](https://www.sefaria.org/II_Samuel.3.4).) According to Hyman, the scribe reports in Rav’s name three times in [Moed Katan 18a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.18a.11-13): twice in aggadah and once in halakhah. Hyman calls the reading “in the name of Rav Pappa” a scribal error.[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The parenthesis introduces the biblical Avital, who is named as Shefatyah’s mother. Hyman’s printed book label is שמואל כ׳.

The linked Bavli attributes all three sayings to Rav Pappa. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=135&lang=en) likewise gives Rav Pappa and says he did not find a report in Rav’s name.

[Dikdukei Soferim](https://www.google.com/books/edition/_/XJfif6up1H4C?hl=en&gbpv=1&pg=RA10-PA58) gives Rav Pappa in its printed-text column and Rav in its manuscript column in all three cases. Hyman judges the Rav Pappa reading a scribal error.
